premise: An abandoned greenhouse completes its last growing cycle; a sprout survives the end of artificial light as dawn arrives.
scope: Storyboard only; no full-film render/publication/spending authorised by this file

shots.title: The abandoned greenhouse
shots.purpose: Establish the place and fragile stakes
shots.action: Wide, slow push between empty trays. Dust, dry stalks, one working growing station in the distance.
shots.camera: Wide 35mm; push forward, preserve tray-to-window geography.
shots.sound: Low room tone, distant wind, irregular relay.
shots.source_and_missing: New greenhouse wide set; avoid uniform darkness.
shots.qa: The single lit station reads within2s; camera never crosses continuity axis.

shots.title: One seed remains
shots.purpose: Give the seed a clear physical origin
shots.action: Close on a nearly empty seed cassette; a small gate unlocks above the familiar tray. Cut before release.
shots.camera: 85mm detail; rack focus from empty slots to the remaining seed.
shots.sound: One quiet mechanical click; sparse tonal bed.
shots.source_and_missing: New cassette/gate prop and release animation.
shots.qa: No extra seeds appear; release direction matches pilot. Caption: Only one seed remained.

shots.title: The last water
shots.purpose: Establish scarcity and prepare the drop
shots.action: Transparent reservoir is almost empty. A final bead gathers at the familiar nozzle; no free-floating water.
shots.camera: 65mm detail; tilt along the supply pipe to nozzle.
shots.source_and_missing: Reservoir and controlled liquid silhouette; connect to existing pipe.
shots.qa: No water reaches soil before pilot; nozzle coordinates match saved set.

shots.title: Seed → drop → sprout
shots.action: Reuse accepted pilot v5 in full: settling/dent/grains, water on seed/runoff, shell opening, green sprout.
shots.camera: Accepted locked macro; preserve all180frames and accepted contact timing.
shots.sound: Reuse original accepted pilot soundtrack segment at unity gain; new bed ducks around it.
shots.source_and_missing: Retained output:pilot-v5; no replacement render required.
shots.qa: Exact7.5s; no crop, retime or change of accepted movement; check audio joins.

shots.title: The light goes out
shots.purpose: A short setback without undoing growth
shots.action: Closer leaf detail with small natural movement; lamp pulses once then fades. Sprout remains upright, small and alive.
shots.camera: 65mm slight lateral slide; near leaf foreground, lamp readable behind.
shots.sound: Mechanical hum stops; room/wind remains, no long dead silence.
shots.source_and_missing: Lamp prop, restrained leaf action and light-state transition.
shots.qa: No static held image; do not regrow the same sprout or imply instant wilting.

shots.title: Dawn finds the leaves
shots.action: A moving warm band of dawn enters through roof glass, reaches the leaves and casts their shadow on soil.
shots.camera: Gentle pan follows light to plant; end on a readable lit leaf.
shots.sound: Warm harmonic slowly opens; small airy texture, no oversized impact.
shots.source_and_missing: Animated light/window shadow; small material/light test needed.
shots.qa: Beam travel is legible, leaf silhouette coherent, exposure never burns white.

shots.title: A living point in the empty room
shots.action: Pull back from the same tray: all other stations are empty; the green sprout catches sunlight. Dust moves subtly.
shots.camera: 35mm slow continuous retreat; keep plant near lower-right third, window opposite.
shots.sound: Sparse restrained musical resolution; room tone persists.
shots.source_and_missing: Wide set reuse fromS01 with dawn state; camera path and gentle dust.
shots.qa: Sprout remains identifiable; same seed/plant scale, tray and pipe geometry.

shots.title: The Last Seed
shots.purpose: Finish the story with a held emotional image
shots.action: Final composed wide: warm window and small living plant. Move for first3s, settle gently; title The Last Seed, then short fade.
shots.camera: Locked ending after slow settle; no new object/reveal.
shots.sound: Final soft chord and room decay; fade with picture.
shots.source_and_missing: English title overlay, final sound mix and fade.
shots.qa: Readable title about2s; final fade contained in6s, no tail added.

transitions: Hard or matched cuts; fades included inside shot durations, no overlapping time deductions

continuity.palette: Retain pilot teal structure, brass tray/nozzle, ochre seed and green leaves; dawn adds warm light
continuity.growth: Same retained seed, stem and leaves, same scale. No new growing cycle afterS04
continuity.geography: Cassette above tray; nozzle connected to supply; window direction fixed throughout
continuity.motion: Small motivated camera/leaf/dust movement; no long frozen holds
continuity.source_policy: Original local geometry/materials and sound; free tools on Mac, heavy jobs sequential

tests.scope: 2s lamp-to-dawn light/shadow transition on saved set
tests.pass: Readable causal change without clipping, flicker or incoherent shadow

tests.scope: Macro/wide control stills from same saved seed/tray/set revision
tests.pass: Matching shape, scale, position, pipe geography and leaf identity

tests.scope: Resume one retained shot after a fresh session and compare controls
tests.pass: Correct source/settings, no duplicate dispatch, selected correction isolated

optional_tests.scope: Three cheap still compositions ofS07 before final wide rendering
Review actual correction frames only if current local player is usable
